newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF's Sakakibara briefs Japan PM on forex rates.
newsitem.headline: MOF's Sakakibara briefs Japan PM on forex rates.

text.p: Senior Ministry of Finance (MOF) official Eisuke Sakakibara said on Friday he had briefed Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on recent currency movements.

Emerging from a meeting with Hashimoto, Sakakibara, head of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, told reporters he made a report on exchange rate movements as the movements had been volatile for the past two weeks.
He said the prime minister did not make any requests regarding exchange rates.
He did not divulge the contents of his report to Hashimoto.
